grammar.explanation: 怕什么啊 may challenge or reassure someone’s fear, rather than ask the name of a feared object. In a friendly conversation it can still sound dismissive; 我陪你 is often kinder. Read context and intonation, and do not infer permission.

examples.py: pà shén me a , wǒ péi nǐ .
examples.en: What is there to fear? I will accompany you.

examples.py: jí shén me a , hái méi dào shí jiān .
examples.en: Why rush? The time has not come yet.

examples.py: xiào shén me a , xiān tīng wǒ shuō wán .
examples.en: What are you laughing at? Hear me out first.

commonMistakes.wrong: 怕什么啊一定是温柔安慰。
commonMistakes.right: 要看语气，也可能显得不耐烦。
commonMistakes.why: The pattern can be dismissive depending on delivery.

grammar.pattern: 并 + 没有 / 不：再辨范围
grammar.explanation: 我并没有取消 denies cancelling; it does not deny changing the room. Retrieve the earlier emphatic negation by specifying exactly what is denied. A strong denial remains an assertion, not external proof.

examples.zh: 我并没有取消，只换了房间。
examples.py: wǒ bìng méi yǒu qǔ xiāo , zhǐ huàn le fáng jiān .
examples.en: I did not cancel; I only changed the room.

examples.py: tā bìng bù tǎo yàn zhè bù jù .
examples.en: She does not dislike this series.

examples.py: wǒ bìng méi yǒu tì nǐ bào míng .
examples.en: I did not register for you.

commonMistakes.wrong: 并没有取消说明地点也没有变。
commonMistakes.right: 没有取消，地点仍可能变了。
commonMistakes.why: The denial has a specified scope.

dialogue.title: A joke at the theatre
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Listen for the problem, the proposed response and the next action.

lines.zh: 你笑什么啊？我还没讲完呢。
lines.py: nǐ xiào shén me a ? wǒ hái méi jiǎng wán ne .
lines.en: What are you laughing at? I haven't finished yet.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我不是笑你。我把咖啡倒进你的杯子里了。
lines.py: wǒ bù shì xiào nǐ . wǒ bǎ kā fēi dào jìn nǐ de bēi zi lǐ le .
lines.en: I'm not laughing at you. I poured my coffee into your cup.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 怪不得这么甜！你到底放了多少糖？
lines.py: guài bù de zhè me tián ! nǐ dào dǐ fàng le duō shao táng ?
lines.en: No wonder it's so sweet! How much sugar did you put in?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 别问了。我再给你买一杯，好不好？
lines.py: bié wèn le . wǒ zài gěi nǐ mǎi yī bēi , hǎo bù hǎo ?
lines.en: Don't ask. I'll get you another cup, okay?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行。对了，明天的连续剧你还看吗？
lines.py: xíng . duì le , míng tiān de lián xù jù nǐ hái kàn ma ?
lines.en: Okay. By the way, are you still watching that drama tomorrow?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 看啊。导演的采访也挺好笑的，我发给你。
lines.py: kàn a . dǎo yǎn de cǎi fǎng yě tǐng hǎo xiào de , wǒ fā gěi nǐ .
lines.en: Of course. The director's interview is pretty funny too. I'll send it to you.
lines.speaker: b

questions.q: Why is the drink surprisingly sweet?
choices: The friend put sugar in the coffee
The café changed its opening time
questions.answer: The friend put sugar in the coffee

reading.title: Warm teasing needs an answer
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Follow what happened and explain the people’s choices from the text.

lines.zh: 周六，我去剧场看朋友的话剧。她热爱表演，练了三个月才第一次上台。
lines.py: zhōu liù , wǒ qù jù chǎng kàn péng you de huà jù . tā rè ài biǎo yǎn , liàn le sān gè yuè cái dì yī cì shàng tái .
lines.en: On Saturday I went to the theatre to see my friend's play. She loves acting and practised for three months before her first performance.

lines.zh: 我刚到门口，她就出来迎接我，把我带到前面的位置。现场比我想象的热闹。
lines.py: wǒ gāng dào mén kǒu , tā jiù chū lái yíng jiē wǒ , bǎ wǒ dài dào qián miàn de wèi zhì . xiàn chǎng bǐ wǒ xiǎng xiàng de rè nào .
lines.en: As soon as I reached the entrance, she came out to greet me and took me to a seat near the front. It was livelier than I'd expected.

lines.zh: 故事发生在一座古城。一个好奇的孩子走到海边，听见远处传来的海浪声。
lines.py: gù shì fā shēng zài yī zuò gǔ chéng . yī gè hào qí de hái zi zǒu dào hǎi biān , tīng jiàn yuǎn chù chuán lái de hǎi làng shēng .
lines.en: The story takes place in an old city. A curious child walks to the shore and hears waves in the distance.

lines.zh: 灯一暗，孩子吓了一跳。旁边的朋友小声说：怕什么啊，我陪你。
lines.py: dēng yī àn , hái zi xià le yī tiào . páng biān de péng you xiǎo shēng shuō : pà shén me a , wǒ péi nǐ .
lines.en: When the lights dim, the child startles. A friend whispers, 'What are you afraid of? I'm here with you.'

lines.zh: 演出结束，我想跟她聊聊最后一场。她说先喝杯咖啡，慢慢聊。
lines.py: yǎn chū jié shù , wǒ xiǎng gēn tā liáo liáo zuì hòu yī chǎng . tā shuō xiān hē bēi kā fēi , màn màn liáo .
lines.en: After the performance I wanted to talk to her about the final scene. She suggested coffee first, so we could take our time.

questions.q: Where does the narrator go on Saturday?
How long did the friend practise?
Why suggest coffee after the performance?
choices: To have time to talk about the play
To rehearse the whole play again
questions.answer: To have time to talk about the play

extraReadings.title: What are you laughing at?

lines.zh: 笑什么啊，我还没讲到好笑的地方。
